title: REMEMBER: Retrieval-based Explainable Multimodal Evidence-guided Modeling for Brain Evaluation and Reasoning in Zero- and Few-shot Neurodegenerative Diagnosis
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development of a retrieval-based multimodal framework for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis. It evaluates performance on medical imaging tasks and explainability, but does not involve religion, faith, ethics, or moral benchmarking.
